Testimonials

What our clients and their families have to say about us…

‘I wanted to say a big thank you to you, Jasmine, Helen and Chris. Steven very much enjoyed his holiday in Northern Ireland. All the photos and videos were great. It was wonderful seeing him looking so happy. I also wanted to thank Anna for doing a very professional risk management of his specific needs and Kevin who was so kind and helpful on the phone when we were booking. We are so grateful that Steven has been able to go on many Go Beyond holidays as we know how kind and trustworthy all the staff are. We hope he can go on many more!’

Parent of a guest

‘Just wanted to thank you all … and it’s only the first week. But more importantly, as I expected, you (and all of the Go Beyond Team) have had a fantastic impact on her health. Absolutely wonderful news.’

Parent of a guest

‘Thank you to the ones who helped me. And thank you, Helen, for all the wonderful delicious meals, they were really yummy.’

Guest

‘I just want to say what a fantastic holiday Jimmy had. He enjoyed the first part of the holiday. He especially loved the second part with the bog walkways and water ways, forest and the beach, and his day trip to Latvia. He looked so happy and relaxed in the holiday photos and videos. Some great photos and the daily videos were a great way to keep connected. I am so grateful, that Jimmy who is always wanting new adventures but is held back by his disabilities from accessing them, can now travel. Go Beyond has given him the possibility of travelling independently ,but supported, and having experiences that that he couldn't possibly have otherwise. So a ‘Big Thank You’ to you and your team.'
